content: Zed ACP agent panel native UX: request_permission renders native dialog buttons from options (Allow once / Always allow / Reject), outcome selected/cancelled returned. tool_call/tool_call_update render as collapsible cards with kind-based icons, inline diffs from content.diff blocks. plan renders native task list. available_commands_update powers slash autocomplete on '/'. thought/message chunks stream natively. Session modes (ask vs auto-accept) advertised via modes field in new_session response render as native dropdown in agent panel bottom bar; selecting triggers session/set_mode; current_mode_update pushes agent-side changes back to the dropdown. Zed 0.186+ shipped ACP; MCP attachable via settings agent.mcpServers. Known early UX issue: Gemini CLI prompts sometimes appeared as raw text instead of dialogs.
